meta.Learning-Teaching Method: Social Constructivism, Inquiry-Based Learning, In-class lecture, Active Learning, Project-based learning
meta.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 22.5h contact hours + 22.5h online hours + 4.5h final project presentation + 1h final exam + 99.5h self-study
meta.Description:
This is a 3-credit course. This course has two parts: online and offline.
The content includes basic concepts and applications of IoT and practical exercises on learning KIT.
Students are taught how to learn online and practice some parts at home. Q&A sessions, Guidance for important issues, and performance assessments will be conducted in the classroom.
meta.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to learn all VIDEOs (theory) online given by instructor on Syllabus at home.
- Student is responsible to do all LABs given by instructor on Syllabus at home.
- Constantly follow https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

chunks.text:
Description: This is a 3-credit course. This course has two parts: online and offline.
The content includes basic concepts and applications of IoT and practical exercises on learning KIT.
Students are taught how to learn online and practice some parts at home. Q&A sessions, Guidance for important issues, and performance assessments will be conducted in the classroom.
NoCredit: 3
Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 22.5h contact hours + 22.5h online hours + 4.5h final project presentation + 1h final exam + 99.5h self-study
StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to learn all VIDEOs (theory) online given by instructor on Syllabus at home.
- Student is responsible to do all LABs given by instructor on Syllabus at home.
- Constantly follow https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.
MinAvgMarkToPass: 5
CLO1: Understand the concept of IoT and applications.
CLO2: Understand the concept of things in IoT.
CLO3: Understand the Networking in IoT.
CLO4: Understand the Securing in IoT.
CLO5: Select and calculate the electronics components, IoT Programming.
CLO6: Program IN/OUT Digital with Arduino UNO.
CLO7: Program Analog Input/Output with Arduino UNO.
CLO8: Program Sensors/Actuators with Arduino UNO.
CLO9: Program Communication with Arduino UNO.
CLO10: Concept planning, Draw and Install simple IoT circuits
CLO11: Understand the Arduino UNO and Atmega328 microcontroller architecture.
CLO12: Know how to use the Simulation Software.
CLO13: Understand the interrupts on Arduino UNO.
